voice.rooms.description: The name of the list of the open voice chat rooms on the rooms' screen, for assistive technology.

voice.rooms_loading.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込んでいます…
voice.rooms_loading.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms while the first of them load.

voice.rooms_loading_more.defaultMessage: 続きのルームを読み込んでいます…
voice.rooms_loading_more.description: Under the voice chat rooms while more load.

voice.rooms_failed.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込めませんでした。
voice.rooms_failed.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.rooms_failed_more.defaultMessage: 続きのルームを読み込めませんでした。
voice.rooms_failed_more.description: Under the voice chat rooms when more could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.rooms_empty.defaultMessage: いま開いているルームはありません。参加できるルームが開くと、ここに表示されます。
voice.rooms_empty.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms when none is open that the reader sees.

voice.back.description: The back button at the top of a voice chat room's page, which leads to the list of rooms.

voice.room_untitled.description: The title of a voice chat room's page while its name is not known or not shown (a visitor of a room whose summary the server does not show).

voice.loading.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込んでいます…
voice.loading.description: In place of a voice chat room while it loads.

voice.failed.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込めませんでした。
voice.failed.description: In place of a voice chat room when it could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.retry.description: The button after a voice chat room's or a list's failure to load that loads it again.

voice.hosted_by.description: Under a voice chat room's title on its page: who hosts it ({host}, a display name).

voice.speakers.description: The heading of the participants of a voice chat room who may speak (the host, the co-hosts, the speakers), and the name of their list.

voice.listeners.description: The heading of the participants of a voice chat room who listen, and the name of their list.

voice.no_listeners.defaultMessage: まだ聞き手はいません。
voice.no_listeners.description: Under the heading Listeners of a voice chat room while it has none.

voice.role_host.description: Under a participant's name in a voice chat room: they host it.

voice.role_cohost.description: Under a participant's name in a voice chat room: they are a co-host.

voice.speaking.description: Said of a participant of a voice chat room while they speak, for assistive technology; their avatar is ringed.

voice.mic_off.description: Said of a speaker of a voice chat room whose microphone is off; a crossed-out microphone on their avatar.

voice.hand.description: Said of a participant of a voice chat room who raised a hand to speak; a hand on their avatar.

voice.blocked.description: Under the name of a participant of a voice chat room whom the reader blocks or who blocks the reader; they are shown, marked, and their reactions are hidden.

voice.join_note.defaultMessage: 参加すると、このルームが見える人全員に、参加者の一覧であなたの名前が表示されます。
voice.join_note.description: Over the Join button of a voice chat room the reader is not in: what joining shows of them.

voice.join_moves.defaultMessage: 参加すると「{room}」から退出します。
voice.join_moves.description: Over the Join button of a voice chat room while the reader is in another one ({room}, its name): one can be in one room at a time.

voice.join_full.defaultMessage: ルームが満員です。しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。
voice.join_full.description: After pressing Join, when the voice chat room has as many people as the server allows.

voice.join_hosting.defaultMessage: 別のルームのホストです。そのルームを終了するか、ホストを渡してから参加してください。
voice.join_hosting.description: After pressing Join, when the reader hosts another open voice chat room.

voice.join.description: The button that joins the reader to a voice chat room, as a listener.

voice.join_unavailable.defaultMessage: このブラウザーでは、このページで通話を使えません。このサーバーのアドレスを https:// で開くか、別のブラウザーを使ってください。
voice.join_unavailable.description: After pressing Join, when the browser gives the page no microphone or sound: the page is not served over HTTPS, or the browser does not support it.

voice.join_failed.defaultMessage: ルームに参加できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.join_failed.description: After pressing Join, when joining failed for any other reason.

voice.connecting.description: In a voice chat room the reader joined, until its connection is up.

voice.reconnecting.defaultMessage: 接続が切れました。再接続しています…
voice.reconnecting.description: In a voice chat room the reader is in, while its connection is down and comes back by itself.

voice.muted_by.defaultMessage: {name} があなたのマイクをオフにしました。もう一度オンにできます。
voice.muted_by.description: In a voice chat room the reader speaks in, after a host or a co-host ({name}, their display name) muted the reader.

voice.muted_by_someone.defaultMessage: ホストがあなたのマイクをオフにしました。もう一度オンにできます。
voice.muted_by_someone.description: In a voice chat room the reader speaks in, after a host or co-host who is no longer listed muted the reader.

voice.mic_failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, denied {ブラウザーがマイクを使えません。サイトの設定で許可してから、もう一度試してください。} missing {マイクが見つかりません。つないでから、もう一度試してください。} busy {ほかのアプリがマイクを使っています。そのアプリを閉じてから、もう一度試してください。} refused {このルームの話者ではなくなりました。もう一度話すには、「挙手」か「話す」を使ってください。} other {マイクをオンにできませんでした。もう一度試してください。}}
voice.mic_failed.description: In a voice chat room, when the reader's microphone could not be turned on: the browser refused it ({reason} denied), there is none (missing), another app holds it (busy), the reader is a listener again and the server did not let them speak (refused; Raise hand and Speak are the controls that ask to speak), or anything else (other).

voice.hear_room.description: The button in a voice chat room, and in the call's bar, while the browser holds the room's sound back until the reader presses something: pressing it plays the sound.

voice.hear_held.defaultMessage: ブラウザーがルームの音声を止めています。
voice.hear_held.description: Beside the Hear the room button in a voice chat room, while the browser holds its sound back until a press.

voice.controls.description: The name of the toolbar of a voice chat room's controls (the microphone, the hand, reactions, leaving), for assistive technology.

voice.mute.description: The microphone's control in a voice chat room while it is on: pressing it turns it off.

voice.unmute.description: The microphone's control in a voice chat room while it is off: pressing it turns it on.

voice.speak.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room who may speak without asking: pressing it makes them a speaker.

voice.listen.description: The control of a speaker of a voice chat room that makes them a listener again.

voice.raise_hand.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room who may not speak without asking: pressing it asks the hosts to let them speak.

voice.lower_hand.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room whose hand is raised: pressing it takes the request back.

voice.react.description: The control of a voice chat room that opens the emoji picker to send a reaction, which everyone in the room sees for a moment.

voice.leave.description: The control of a voice chat room that leaves it.

voice.act_failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, speak {話し始める操作} listen {話すのをやめる操作} raise {挙手} lower {挙手の取り下げ} leave {退出} other {リアクション}}を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.act_failed.description: In a voice chat room, when the server refused or did not answer what the reader pressed: action is which of them (speak, listen to stop speaking, raise or lower the hand, leave, or other: sending a reaction).

voice.host_must_choose.defaultMessage: このルームのホストです。退出するには、ルームを終了するか、参加者のだれかにホストを渡してください。
voice.host_must_choose.description: In a voice chat room, when its host pressed Leave while others are in it: the server keeps them in until they choose.

voice.end_room.description: The button beside the notice that the host must choose before leaving: it ends the voice chat room for everyone.

voice.output.description: The name of the choice, in a voice chat room, of the speakers or headphones the room's sound plays on.

voice.output_default.description: The first choice of the sound output in a voice chat room: the device's default speakers.

voice.output_unnamed.description: A choice of the sound output in a voice chat room whose device the browser does not name until the site may use the microphone ({number}, its place in the list).

voice.end.defaultMessage: {kind, select, removed {{reason, select, removed {ホストがあなたを「{room}」から退出させました。このルームにはもう参加できません。} blocked {ブロックのため「{room}」から退出しました。} suspended {アカウントが凍結されたため「{room}」から退出しました。} disconnected {接続が切れたため「{room}」から退出しました。} other {「{room}」から退出しました。}}} replaced {別の端末で「{room}」に参加したため、この端末では退出しました。} ended {{reason, select, host {ホストが「{room}」を終了しました。} moderator {モデレーターが「{room}」を終了しました。} time_limit {「{room}」は時間の上限に達して終了しました。} disabled {このサーバーで通話が無効になったため、「{room}」は終了しました。} host_disconnected {ホストの接続が切れたため、「{room}」は終了しました。} other {「{room}」は終了しました。}}} lost {「{room}」への接続が切れました。} other {「{room}」の音声が使えなくなったため、退出しました。}}
voice.end.description: Why the reader is no longer in the voice chat room {room} (its name), on its page and in a toast on the other screens: {kind} removed (with {reason}: removed by a host, blocked, suspended, disconnected), replaced (joined on another device), ended (with {reason}: why the room ended), lost (the server dropped the session), or other (the sound failed).

voice.end_close.description: The button at the end of the toast that says why the reader is no longer in a voice chat room.

voice.ended.defaultMessage: このルームは終了しました。
voice.ended.description: On the page of a voice chat room that ended, under its name when the server shows it.

voice.unavailable.defaultMessage: このルームは開いていないか、あなたには見えません。
voice.unavailable.description: On the page of a voice chat room the reader does not see: it never was, or it is not shown to them.

voice.local_only.defaultMessage: このサーバーにアカウントがある人だけが、ルームに参加できます。
voice.local_only.description: On the page of a voice chat room for a visitor who is not signed in, beside the sign-in button.

voice.open_now.description: On a voice chat room's page for a visitor, while the room is open and the server shows its summary.

voice.off.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは通話を使えません。
voice.off.description: On a voice chat page while the server has voice chat turned off.

voice.open_hosted_by.description: On a voice chat room's page for a visitor, under its name, while the room is open and the server shows its summary with its host ({host}, a display name).

voice.end_open.description: The action of the toast that says why the reader is no longer in a voice chat room: it opens the room's page, which says it again.

voice.rooms_more.description: The button under the voice chat rooms that loads the next of them.

voice.self.description: Under the name on the reader's own tile among the participants of a voice chat room: the tile is theirs. A line of its own, which a long name never cuts.

voice.sign_in_join.description: The button on a voice chat room's page for a visitor who is not signed in: the sign-in, which comes back to the room, where they can join it.
